This is shown in many moments: Riley remembering memories that the emotions didn't call up, like the penalty she committed during a hockey game. Anxiety being unable to force Riley to join the opposite team to her best friend's because of that being against her beliefs. Even after Joy was able to replace the Sense of Self created by Anxiety with the old one and take the latter from the console, Riley's anxiety attack continued, only stopping when Joy allowed a new Sense of Self (created from both good and bad beliefs) to emerge and she and the other emotions comforted Riley.
